title.narrative: Capacity-building for a clean energy transition of the household energy sector in the Democratic People#s Republic of Korea

description.narrative: In response to its policy of increasing the share of renewable energy in the overall energy mix of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPR Korea), this project seeks to provide technical assistance to DPR Korea in transitioning from dependence on fossil fuels by building internal capacities for utilizing bioenergy resource potential in the country. The project was prepared in response to the request submitted by the Permanent Mission of the DPR Korea in Vienna, and subsequent co nsultations made with key stakeholders in the country during a fact-finding mission fielded by the Department of Energy (ENE) in response to that request. Identified needs to scale up the utilization of bio-energy resources include the need to strengthen planning and coordination capacities among key enabling institutions, build technical capacities among a cohort of professionals in the design, installation and operation of bio-energy conversion technologies and systems, and exposure to best practices and lessons learned from the experience of other countries.
